environment.description: Apollo GraphQL server deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f8b2c1d) in VPC vpc-9f8e7d6c with instance role 'graphql-service-role' attached. Instance has IMDSv1 enabled (HttpTokens: optional). The instance role has policies granting s3:*, ec2:Describe*, and sts:AssumeRole on cross-account roles. No network ACLs restrict outbound from the instance to 169.254.169.254. Security group sg-abc123 allows all outbound traffic. No permission boundaries attached to the role.
